# Head of Engineering

Lead a distributed engineering organisation through growth and change while retaining hands-on technical credibility.

## Required

- Engineering management, coaching, hiring and team development
- Predictable delivery, release governance and quality standards
- Architecture strategy, cloud platforms and legacy modernisation
- Application security, technical risk and incident ownership
- Clear communication with product, commercial and executive stakeholders

## Preferred

- DevOps and CI/CD transformation
- Budget and resource planning
- Experience in a resource-constrained product company
